errors.evidence: The description states that the circular markers for the Austria line appear at the same five-year intervals as the markers for the Germany line. This is incorrect. The Germany line has markers at 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2020. The Austria line has markers only at 2005, 2010, and 2020; it does not have a marker at 2015.

errors.text_span: fällt danach wieder auf knapp unter 0,50 Prozent im Jahr 2017
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies a specific point in the trend for Austria. The line does not fall to a specific value 'in the year 2017'. After the 2015 peak, the line reaches a local minimum around the year 2018 at a value of approximately 0.4%. The value in 2017 is approximately 0.45%, and it is not the bottom of the dip.
